purpose: Expand saved candidate review across related queries using explicit occurrence context, without promoting identity mappings.

rules.C1: Use the occurrence name and explicit PlantPart, Genus and Species notes. Preserve all attributes and original evidence; never borrow sibling or product-title context.
rules.C2: Match saved query families by case/whitespace normalization and removal of a bounded set of plant-part/preparation/form words. Normalize leaves to leaf, roots to root and HCl to hydrochloride. Preserve all other tokens, punctuation, brands, quantities and salts.
rules.C3: A related query may add candidates only if every query scope qualifier is explicitly supported by the occurrence. Do not broaden blends, negated descriptions or qualifiers from ambiguous notes.
rules.C4: Assess target scope separately from query scope. Conflicting explicit plant parts, preparation types or chemical forms block preference; unsupported allergenic preparations are excluded from exact matching. Missing scope, whole-extract ambiguity, inactive status and PubChem specificity remain pending.
rules.C5: Rank fully aligned active saved targets first for review; tied candidates remain tied. Ranking is not identity confidence or approval.
rules.C6: Retain all prior decisions unchanged, including exclusions. Added candidates remain Medium/pending or Low/conflicting, with no proposed identity relationship and graph_applied=false. Do not resolve historical no-candidate queries retroactively.

limitations: Bounded lexical discovery, not exhaustive synonym, taxonomy or chemical resolution.
No new High-confidence identity links, canonical merges, clinical approvals or graph writes.
Preparation/standardization/strain information remains in source attributes and must be reviewed even for highest-priority candidates.
